stem.text: A car travels at a constant speed along a straight line PQ.
A loudspeaker attached to the car emits sound of constant frequency $f$. A stationary observer is at point O.

stem.alt: Car on a straight horizontal line from P to Q, with an arrow along the line; a stationary observer O above Q; labels P, Q and O.

stem.text: What does the observer hear as the car moves from P towards Q?

A.text: a frequency less than $f$ that decreases as the car moves from P towards Q

B.text: a frequency less than $f$ that increases as the car moves from P towards Q

C.text: a frequency more than $f$ that decreases as the car moves from P towards Q

D.text: a frequency more than $f$ that increases as the car moves from P towards Q
